title: Meta’s ads MCP server comes to Databricks: Put your customer intelligence to work in advertising campaigns
key_facts: Meta's ads MCP server is now available in Databricks Marketplace.
Connected to Databricks' Genie assistant, marketers can ask in plain language about Meta campaign performance alongside their company data.
The server exposes more than 25 tools covering creating campaigns, changing budgets and bids, audiences, creative and performance data.
Administrators control access through Unity Catalog; Unity Gateway governs tool calls and keeps audit logs.
Meta lets advertisers set rules, such as blocking any budget rise over 20%, which the server enforces on every tool call.
Setup uses a Meta user access token and the required permissions.
quote_evidence: The ads MCP server from Meta, now available in Databricks Marketplace, gives marketers a more direct path from those insights to campaign decisions.
The server checks every tool call against those rules before it executes.
why_it_matters_hint: AI agents can act on ad accounts under budget rules set by the advertiser.
notes: Databricks promotional blog; Meta's rules are described by Databricks.
